patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large, abstract 3D graphic on one side, partially overlaid by a browser-like product UI mockup, with primary content and CTAs positioned on the other side.

Utilizes a very large, bold, sans-serif typeface for primary headings, creating strong visual impact, complemented by a clear, readable sans-serif for body text and a monospaced font for technical UI elements.
A clean, minimalist palette dominated by white backgrounds and dark charcoal text, punctuated by a vibrant, warm orange accent color used for key graphics, call-to-action buttons, and highlights.
A large, flowing orange graphic in the hero section exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content and product mockup, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections throughout the page are introduced with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.

Product feature sections are presented as a mix of two-column layouts with text and supporting visuals, and grid-based cards with icons and short descriptions, maintaining a consistent visual language.

technique_notes: A large, abstract 3D graphic is positioned as a background element in the hero, animated to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content and product mockup, creating a parallax depth effect.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations that apply a subtle fade-in and upward translation as each section enters the user's viewport.
The main navigation bar and a persistent 'Ask' button are fixed to the viewport, ensuring they remain accessible regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) with clear, legible body text and smaller, subtle labels for UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 8-12px) applied consistently to buttons, cards, and UI elements, providing a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with balanced spacing within content blocks and grids to maintain readability and visual hierarchy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, flowing, abstract 3D graphic element that dynamically integrates with product mockups and provides a subtle background parallax effect. This graphic adds a unique visual identity and a sense of modern, sophisticated technology without being overly complex or distracting.
